Hi Nina — thanks for the docs, got them.

A few quick confirmations so we create the vendor record correctly:
- Legal name on file: we need the full legal entity name as it appears on the W-9 (line 1). If you prefer the parent holding name we can capture DBA/branch as an alternate.
- Tax ID/EIN: please confirm the 9-digit EIN you want associated with the profile.
- Billing address for PO (bill-to) vs delivery address (ship-to): we typically put the bill-to on the vendor master and attach a ship-to on the PO. If you have a centralized AP processing address please provide.
- Preferred PO contact: name, email, phone (we will populate PO routing and the AP notification).

I attached a short PO routing form (ANL_PO_Routing_Form.xlsx) and a vendor portal invite link — if you can fill the form and reply, we can route to Finance for creation. Karthik, Jonas — can you confirm the internal SLA for turning these into a live vendor once we receive the completed form and EIN?

Monica Patel
